name: MMMU: A Massive Multi-Discipline Multimodal Understanding and Reasoning Benchmark
description: MMMU is an advanced benchmark evaluating multimodal foundation models on university-level multimodal understanding and domain-specific reasoning tasks. Created by Ohio State University, University of Waterloo, and IN.AI Research, it spans 11,500 collegiate examination problems across 6 core disciplines and 30 academic subjects including science, engineering, business, and medicine that require complex visual diagram parsing and joint reasoning.

size.notes: 11,550 college-level questions across 6 core disciplines and 30 academic subjects involving charts, diagrams, chemical structures, and sheet music. Official benchmark splits comprise 150 few-shot development questions (5 per subject), 900 validation questions (30 per subject), and 10,500 test questions.
